answer: Old staking locked funds once and trusted the identity forever, letting forgers buy one good audit and idle for months. A lease fixes that flaw. Each identity rents standing for 10 epochs at 80 units, and renewal needs fresh proof of work and a clean record. Without renewal the identity lapses and the fee is kept. The orchard bears fruit only while tended. A terrace of 1,000 fakes pays 80,000 units per lease cycle, and each renewal audit catches about 30%, burning 24,000 units. The zenith is never permanent: each identity re-earns its place. Honest agents renew cheaply.
